31966-cathedrals-of-spain.title: Cathedrals Of Spain
31966-cathedrals-of-spain.creator: John Allyne Gade
31966-cathedrals-of-spain.description: A book by John Allyne Gade. Nowhere else in Spain, and certainly in few places outside her borders, can one take in the whole architectural development of successive styles and ages so comprehensively as in Salamanca. Byzantine and Romanesque, Gothic from its first fire to the last flicker and coldness of the ashes, and the triumphant domination of the reborn classicism,--all are massed together here.

40572-the-flying-bo-sun-a-mystery-of-the.title: A Mystery of the Sea
40572-the-flying-bo-sun-a-mystery-of-the.creator: Arthur Mason
40572-the-flying-bo-sun-a-mystery-of-the.description: A book by Arthur Mason. But it is often true that real men learn thereby to handle their fellow-men, to love them, and to make the most of their own manhood. In no class is this more marked than among those who have been formed by the training of the sea.

60475-peggy-s-giant.title: Peggy’S Giant
60475-peggy-s-giant.creator: M. D. Hillyard
60475-peggy-s-giant.description: A book by M. D. Hillyard. Peggy had just finished her birthday tea up in the nursery alone with Nurse, as Mother was away. Of course it hadn’t been nearly so exciting as her last birthday tea--the only one she could remember--which had been downstairs with lots of other little girls and boys, who had all come to see Peggy.

63114-stories-pictures-tell-book-5.title: Book Five
63114-stories-pictures-tell-book-5.creator: Flora L. Carpenter
63114-stories-pictures-tell-book-5.description: A book by Flora L. Carpenter. =Questions to arouse interest.= Of what is this a picture? What are the three women doing in the field? What have they in their hands? Of what use are their aprons? Why do you think their work is hard? Why do you think they are used to it? How are they dressed? What story is told in the background? What do you suppose the man on horseback is doing? What can you see beyond the people? What time of the year is it?

arxiv-1609-09721.title: Twisted spacetime in Einstein gravity
arxiv-1609-09721.creator: Hongsheng Zhang 1 , 2 {}^{1,2~}
arxiv-1609-09721.description: Abstract We find a vacuum stationary twisted solution in four-dimensional Einstein gravity. Its frame dragging angular velocities are antisymmetric with respect to the equatorial plane. It possesses a symmetry of joint inversion of time and parity with respect to the equatorial plane. Its Arnowitt-Deser-Misner (ADM) mass and angular momentum are zero. It is curved but regular all over the manifold.

arxiv-2103-04968.title: A note on local uniqueness of equilibria: How isolated is a local equilibrium?
arxiv-2103-04968.creator: Stefano Matta, (University of Cagliari)
arxiv-2103-04968.description: Abstract Abstract : The motivation of this note is to show how singular values affect local uniqueness. More precisely, Theorem 3.1 shows how to construct a neighborhood (a ball) of a regular equilibrium whose diameter represents an estimate of local uniqueness, hence providing a measure of how isolated a (local) unique equilibrium can be.

arxiv-2107-05660.title: NICER, NuSTAR, and Swift follow-up observations of the γ \gamma -ray flaring blazar BL Lacertae in 2020 August–October
arxiv-2107-05660.creator: F. D’Ammando
arxiv-2107-05660.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by F. D’Ammando. During a period of strong γ \gamma -ray flaring activity from BL Lacertae, we organized Swift , Neutron star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER) , and Nuclear Spectroscopic Telescope Array (NuSTAR) follow-up observations. The source has been monitored by Swift -XRT (X-ray Telescope) between 2020 August 11 and October 16, showing a variability amplitude of 65, with a flux varying between 1.0 × \times 10 -11 and 65.3 × \times 10 -11 erg cm -2 s -1 .

arxiv-2111-01140.title: Transforming gas-rich low-mass disky galaxies into ultra-diffuse galaxies by ram pressure
arxiv-2111-01140.creator: Kirill A. Grishin 1,2,8, Igor V. Chilingarian 3,1,8, Anton V. Afanasiev 4,5,1,8, Daniel Fabricant 3, Ivan Yu. Katkov 6,1, Sean Moran 3, Masafumi Yagi 7
arxiv-2111-01140.description: Abstract Faint extended elliptically-shaped ultra-diffuse galaxies and slightly brighter and more compact dwarf elliptical and lenticular stellar systems are common in galaxy clusters. Their poorly constrained evolutionary paths can be studied by identifying young ultra-diffuse galaxy and dwarf elliptical analogs populated with bright, massive stars.

arxiv-2304-02130.title: Swarming models with specular boundary condition and environmental noise
arxiv-2304-02130.creator: Razvan C. Fetecau, Hui Huang, Jinniao Qiu
arxiv-2304-02130.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Razvan C. Fetecau, Hui Huang, Jinniao Qiu. We investigate a general class of models for swarming/self-collective behaviour in domains with boundaries. The model is expressed as a stochastic system of interacting particles subject to both reflecting boundary condition and common environmental noise. We rigorously derive its corresponding macroscopic mean-field equation, which is a new type of stochastic partial differential equation due to the presence of common noise.

arxiv-2310-02094.title: CoNO: Complex Neural Operator for Continuous Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2310-02094.creator: Karn Tiwari, N M Anoop Krishnan, Prathosh A P
arxiv-2310-02094.description: Abstract Neural operators extend data-driven models to map between infinite-dimensional functional spaces. These models have successfully solved continuous dynamical systems represented by differential equations, viz weather forecasting, fluid flow, or solid mechanics. However, the existing operators still rely on real space, thereby losing rich representations potentially captured in the complex space by functional transforms.

arxiv-2403-04770.title: Social Orientation: A New Feature for Dialogue Analysis
arxiv-2403-04770.description: Abstract There are many settings where it is useful to predict and explain the success or failure of a dialogue. Circumplex theory from psychology models the social orientations (e.g., Warm-Agreeable , Arrogant-Calculating ) of conversation participants and can be used to predict and explain the outcome of social interactions.

arxiv-2409-13981.title: Robust Single-Photon Generation for Quantum Information Enabled by Stimulated Adiabatic Rapid Passage
arxiv-2409-13981.creator: Yusuf Karli, René Schwarz, Florian Kappe, Daniel A. Vajner, Ria G. Krämer, Thomas K. Bracht, Saimon F. Covre da Silva, Daniel Richter, Stefan Nolte, Armando Rastelli, Doris E. Reiter, Gregor Weihs, Tobias Heindel, Vikas Remesh
arxiv-2409-13981.description: Abstract The generation of single photons using solid-state quantum emitters is pivotal for advancing photonic quantum technologies, particularly in quantum communication. As the field continuously advances towards practical use cases and beyond shielded laboratory environments, specific demands are placed on the robustness of quantum light sources during operation.

arxiv-2508-15569.title: Conformalized Exceptional Model Mining: Telling Where Your Model Performs (Not) Well
arxiv-2508-15569.creator: Xin Du, Sikun Yang(✉), Wouter Duivesteijn, Mykola Pechenizkiy
arxiv-2508-15569.description: Abstract Understanding the nuanced performance of machine learning models is essential for responsible deployment, especially in high-stakes domains like healthcare and finance. This paper introduces a novel framework, Conformalized Exceptional Model Mining, which combines the rigor of Conformal Prediction with the explanatory power of Exceptional Model Mining (EMM).

arxiv-2509-04218.title: Bright siren without electromagnetic counterpart by LISA-Taiji-TianQin network
arxiv-2509-04218.creator: Yejing Zhan, David Izquierdo-Villalba, Xiao Guo, Qing Yang, Daniele Spinoso, Fa-Yin Wang
arxiv-2509-04218.description: Abstract Gravitational waves (GWs) with electromagnetic counterparts (EMc) offer a novel approach to measure the Hubble constant ( H 0 H_{0} ), known as bright sirens, enabling H 0 H_{0} measurements by combining GW-derived distances with EM-derived redshifts. Host galaxy identification is essential for redshift determination but remains challenging due to poor GW sky localization and uncertainties in EMc models.

arxiv-2512-07633.title: Chiral transition in a Non-Abelian Quasi-Particle Model with three quark flavours Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2512-07633.creator: E. P. Politis, A. Tsapalis, F. K. Diakonos
arxiv-2512-07633.description: Abstract We combine the recently introduced Non-Abelian Quasi-Particle Model (NAQPM) for gluons with an ideal Fermi gas of three quark species with the aim to describe the equation of state (energy density vs. temperature) of 2 + 1 2+1 - flavour Lattice-QCD at zero chemical potential.

arxiv-2601-11718.title: Discovery of High X-Ray Polarization from the Neutron Star Low-Mass X-Ray Binary Cyg X-2 in the Horizontal Branch
arxiv-2601-11718.creator: Andrea Gnarini, Swati Ravi, Philip Kaaret, Anna Bobrikova, Juri Poutanen, Sofia V. Forsblom, Francesco Ursini, Maria Cristina Baglio, Stefano Bianchi, Fiamma Capitanio, Massimo Cocchi, María Alejandra Díaz Teodori, Sergio Fabiani, Ruben Farinelli, Giorgio Matt, Mason Ng, Alexander Salganik, Paolo So
arxiv-2601-11718.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Andrea Gnarini, Swati Ravi, Philip Kaaret, Anna Bobrikova, Juri Poutanen, Sofia V. Forsblom, Francesco Ursini, Maria Cristina Baglio, Stefano Bianchi, Fiamma Capitanio, Massimo Cocchi, María Alejandra Díaz Teodori, Sergio Fabiani, Ruben Farinelli, Giorgio Matt, Mason Ng, Alexander Salganik, Paolo So. We present results from simultaneous X-ray polarimetric and spectroscopic observations of the bright neutron star low-mass X-ray binary Cyg X-2 , performed by the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) and the Nuclear Spectroscopic Telescope Array (NuSTAR).

arxiv-2602-06960.title: InftyThink + : Effective and Efficient Infinite-Horizon Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2602-06960.creator: Yuchen Yan, Liang Jiang, Jin Jiang, Shuaicheng Li, Zujie Wen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou, Jian Shao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
arxiv-2602-06960.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuchen Yan, Liang Jiang, Jin Jiang, Shuaicheng Li, Zujie Wen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou, Jian Shao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen. Large reasoning models achieve strong performance by scaling inference-time chain-of-thought, but this paradigm suffers from quadratic cost, context length limits, and degraded reasoning due to lost-in-the-middle effects. Iterative reasoning mitigates these issues by periodically summarizing intermediate thoughts, yet existing methods rely on supervised learning or fixed heuristics and fail to optimize when to summarize, what to preserve, and how to resume reasoning.

arxiv-2602-20058.title: The effect of the A-site cation on the phase transition temperature of metal halide perovskites
arxiv-2602-20058.creator: Tom Braeckevelt, Sander Vandenhaute, Sven M. J. Rogge, Johan Hofkens, Veronique Van Speybroeck †,
arxiv-2602-20058.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Tom Braeckevelt, Sander Vandenhaute, Sven M. J. Rogge, Johan Hofkens, Veronique Van Speybroeck †,. A key challenge for the practical application of metal halide perovskites (MHPs) is the instability of the desired perovskite phase relative to the optically non-active δ \delta phase. To determine the phase stability, we previously developed a procedure to compute the harmonic free energy as a function of temperature, which was suited for CsPbI 3 but fails when Cs is replaced by organic cations due to their rotational freedom.

pmc-10512500.creator: Maxwell. O. Akanbi, Lucy. A. Bilaver, Chad Achenbach, Lisa. R. Hirschhorn, Adovich. S. Rivera, Orimisan. S. Adekolujo, Kehinde. U. A. Adekola, Olugbenga. A. Silas, Patricia. A. Agaba, Oche Agbaji, Nathan. Y. Shehu, Solomon. A. Sagay, Lifang Hou, Robert. L. Murphy
pmc-10512500.description: IntroductionThe expansion of antiretroviral therapy (ART) eligibility could lead to earlier initiation of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) treatment and consequently reduce the risk of HIV-associated Kaposi Sarcoma (KS). We investigated the impact of changes in the Nigerian HIV treatment guidelines on KS incidence among adults enrolled in HIV care in Nigeria.

A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). n the US, diseases and dysfunctions due to plastic cost 1.2% of its Gross Domestic Product annually.1 Additionally, plastic exposures drive racial and ethnic disparities in chronic disease.2

pmc-11688709.creator: Valerie Keller
pmc-11688709.description: Based on personal accounts of people living with dementia this study examines how people affected react on mechanism of societal exclusion such as pathologization, vulnerabilization and disempowerment. Although it has been called for citizenship of people affected in dementia activism and dementia studies for decades, public voices of people with dementia still remain unheard.

pmc-12576755.title: Metagenomic analysis of gut microbiome and spondyloarthropathy: A systematic review
pmc-12576755.creator: Madhan Jeyaraman, Easwar Balasubramanian, Naveen Jeyaraman, Arulkumar Nallakumarasamy, Sathish Muthu
pmc-12576755.description: BACKGROUNDSpondyloarthritis (SpA), a prevalent chronic inflammatory disorder, predominantly impacts the axial skeleton, including the spine and sacroiliac joints. Emerging evidence implicates gut dysbiosis in the pathogenesis of SpA.AIMTo evaluate the association between gut microbiome alterations and SpA through metagenomic sequencing analyses.METHODSA systematic review was conducted by querying English-language databases, including PubMed, EMBASE, and Google Scholar, spanning 2000 to 2023.

This guideline was developed with the goal of improving patient outcomes and reducing complications, based on the latest research related to the application and prescription of CKRT.

pmc-13280534.title: Teachers’ Well-Being and Health in Germany: Representative Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13280534.creator: Rebekka Schröder, Tim Hamer, Ralf Suhr, Lars König, Stephanie Law, Genevieve Pinto Zipp
pmc-13280534.description: BackgroundTeachers play a fundamental role in the educational system and carry significant responsibilities. However, various occupational demands may compromise their health and well-being. At present, empirical data on the specific correlates of health and well-being among teachers in Germany remain limited, for example, regarding the relevance of health literacy.

pmc-13397898.title: Biological Maturation and Physical Performance in Youth Football: Associations Across Professional and Non-Professional Environments
pmc-13397898.creator: Manuel Amore, Maria Francesca Piacentini, Vincenzo Sorgente, Francesco Sera, Diego Minciacchi
pmc-13397898.description: Background: Biological maturation is a major determinant of physical performance in youth football, although the previous evidence suggests that training context may influence maturation–performance associations. This study investigated the association between biological maturation and physical performance in youth football players from professional and non-professional settings.
